claim_boundary: The five-term decomposition is an exact linear attribution of Vina 1.1.2 scores reconstructed on 512 ligands and nine targets after SDF-to-PDBQT pose roundtripping. Term shares may be negative and are not independent variance fractions. Every removal keeps the Vina-selected pose fixed; no result estimates which pose would be selected if a term were removed during search, and no result establishes docking accuracy or biological mechanism.

quality_support_sensitivity.effective_torsion_rule: within-ligand max minus min effective Vina torsion count across targets must be <=0.01
quality_support_sensitivity.score_roundtrip_rule: maximum absolute rescored-minus-released score across targets must be <=0.10 kcal/mol; released scores are displayed to 0.1 kcal/mol

reproducibility_boundary.analysis_from_frozen_terms: The SI table and all downstream attribution summaries are reproducible from results/dockstring_vina_terms/cell_terms.csv.gz and selected_ligands.csv in the release environment.
reproducibility_boundary.pose_selection: top poses selected by Vina and held fixed
reproducibility_boundary.source_restricted_upstream: Recreating cell_terms.csv.gz additionally requires the external Figshare DOCKSTRING top-pose archives, Dockstring receptor resources, the exact Vina 1.1.2 and Open Babel executables identified by hashes, and the documented SDF-to-PDBQT roundtrip. It is outside the standard build.

scope.interpretation: Attribution of retained-pose Vina scores; not a causal re-docking ablation
scope.ligand_conversion: Published top-pose SDF converted to PDBQT with Open Babel 3.1.0, Gasteiger charges, and explicit hydrogens added to the archived prepared graph, without a second pH-dependent protonation step
scope.pose_roundtrip_limit: The original docked ligand PDBQT torsion trees were not published; the archived SDF-to-PDBQT roundtrip is audited against released scores, and conclusions are repeated on a <=0.10 kcal/mol reproduction support
scope.sample_rule: simple random subset (seed 20260802) of the frozen 15,000-ligand DOCKSTRING support selected with NumPy seed 71

score_reproduction.term_rounding_method: The five direct Vina 1.1.2 terms are printed to finite precision; a common per-cell multiplicative correction makes their weighted sum equal the zero-rot affinity before torsional normalisation

gauss1.analysis_boundary: linear score attribution and term removal on fixed Vina-selected poses; not an independent re-docking ablation
